Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১) If the price of a book is first decreased by 25% and then increased by 20%, then the net charges in the price will be :
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the original price be Tk. 100
New final price :
= 120% of (75% of Tk. 100)
= (120/ 100 × 75/ 100 ×100)
= Tk. 90
∴ Decrease = 10%

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২) Three candidates contested an election and received 1136, 7636 and 11628 votes respectively. What percentage of the total votes did the winning candidate get?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Total number of votes polled = (1136 + 7636 + 11628) = 20400.
Required percentage =(11628/20400)x 100%
= 57%.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৩) If 20% of a = b, then b% of 20 is the same as:
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
20% of a = b          
so, (20/100)a = b.
b% of 20 =(b/100)x 20
= (20/100)a x (1/100) x 20        
= (4/100)a
= 4% of a.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৪) In a mixture of milk and water, the proportion of milk by weight was 80%. If, in a 180 gm mixture, 36 gms of pure milk is added, what would be the percentage of milk in the mixture formed?
৫) There are 600 boys in a hostel. Each plays either hockey or football or both. If 75% play hockey and 45% play football, how many play both ?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
n(A)=(75/100 ×600)=450        
n(B)=(45/100 ×600)=270        
∴n(A∩B) =n(A)+n(B)−n(A∪B)
n(A∪B) −600 =(450+270−600) =120

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৬) The contents of a certain box consist of 14 apples and 23 oranges. How many oranges must be removed from the box so that 70% of the pieces of fruit in the box will be apples ?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Total number of fruits = (14 + 23) = 37
Let x oranges be removed.
Then,
70% of (37 - x) = 14
⇒ 7 (37 - x) = 140
⇒ 37 - x = 20
⇒ x = 17

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৭) In an examination it is required to get 40% of the aggregate marks to pass. A student get 261 marks and is declared failed by 4% marks. What are the maximum aggregate marks a student can get ?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the maximum marks be x.
Then,
(40−4)% of x =261
⇒ 36% of x =261
⇒ 36x/100 =261
⇒ x = (261×100/36)
⇒ x = 725

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৮) From a container having pure milk, 20% is replaced by water and the process is repeated thrice. At the end of the third operation, the milk is :
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let total quantity of original milk = 1000 gm
Milk after first operation = 80% of 1000 = 800 gm
Milk after second operation = 80% of 800 = 640 gm
Milk after third operation = 80% of 640 = 512 gm
∴ Strength of final mixture = 51.2%

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৯) Two numbers are respectively 20% and 50% of the third number. What percent is the first number of the second ?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the 3rd number is 100
According to the question,
1st :2nd: 3rd= 20:50:100
Required % = (20/50) × 100 = 40%

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১০) In an election between two candidates, the winner got 65% of the total votes cast and won the election by a majority of 2748 votes. What is the total number of votes cast if no vote is declared invalid?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Winner gets 65% 0f valid votes and loser gets 35% of votes.
Difference between this two = 2748
(65-35)% = 2748
30% = 2748
Total number of voters, 100%
= (2748×100)/30
= 9160

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১১) The price of a car depreciates in the first year by 25%, in the second year by 20% , in third year by 15% and so on. The final price of the car after 3 years, if the present cost of the car is Tk.10,00,000-
১২) (X% of Y) + (Y% of X) is equal to:
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
According to question,        
XY/100 + YX/100
= 2XY/100
= 2% o fXY

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১৩) 40 is subtracted from 60% of a number, the result is 50. Find the number?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the number be x
The problem could be 40 is subtracted from 60% of a number, the result is 50.
60% of x = 60/100×x= 60x/100
60x/100 - 40 = 50
(60x - 4000) /100 = 50
Cross multiplication
60x - 4000 = 50 ×100
60x -4000 = 5000
60x = 5000 + 4000
60x = 9000
x = 9000/60
x = 150
Hence, the number is 150

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১৪) After decreasing 24% in the price of an article costs Tk.912. Find the actual cost of an article?
১৫) How much water must be added to a bucket which contains 40 liters of milk at the cost price of Tk 3.50 per liter so that the cost of milk reduces to Tk 2 per liter?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Total cost price = Tk (40 x 7/2) = Tk 140
Cost per litre = Tk n2,
Total quantity = 140/2 = 70 Litres.
Water to be added =(70-40) =30 Litres.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১৬) A vessel of capacity 90 litres is fully filled with pure milk. Nine litres of milk is removed from the vessel and replaced with water. Nine litres of the solution thus formed is removed and replaced with water. Find the quantity of pure milk in the final milk solution?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the initial quantity of milk in vessel be T litres.
Let us say y litres of the mixture is taken out and replaced by water for n times, alternatively.
Quantity of milk finally in the vessel is then given by [(T - y)/T]n × T
For the given problem, T = 90, y = 9 and n = 2.
Hence, quantity of milk finally in the vessel
= [(90 - 9)/90]2 (90) =  72.9 litres.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১৭) In what ratio should a variety of rice costing Tk. 6 per kg be mixed with another variety of rice costing Tk. 8.75 per kg to obtain a mixture costing Tk 7.50 per kg?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let us say the ratio of the quantities of cheaper and dearer varieties = x : y
By the rule of allegation, x/y = (87.5 - 7.50) / (7.50 - 6) = 5/6

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১৮) In a can, there is a mixture of milk and water in the ratio 4 : 5. If it is filled with an additional 8 litres of milk the can would be full and ratio of milk and water would become 6 : 5. Find the capacity of the can?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the capacity of the can be T litres.
Quantity of milk in the mixture before adding milk = 4/9 (T - 8)
After adding milk, quantity of milk in the mixture = 6/11 T.
6T/11 - 8 = 4/9(T - 8)
10T = 792 - 352
=> T = 44

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ১৯) How many liters of oil at Tk.40 per liter should be mixed with 240 liters of a second variety of oil at Tk.60 per liter so as to get a mixture whose cost is Tk.52 per liter?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Apply Allegation Method and first calculate the ratio in which they have to be mixed.
= 8 : 12 = 2 : 3
Thus, the two varieties of oil should be mixed in the ratio 2 : 3. So, if 240 liters of the second variety are taken, then 160 liters of the first variety should be taken.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২০) A mixture of 150 liters of wine and water contains 20% water. How much more water should be added so that water becomes 25% of the new mixture?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Number of liters of water in150 liters of the mixture = 20% of 150 = 20/100 × 150 = 30 liters.
P liters of water added to the mixture to make water 25% of the new mixture.
Total amount of water becomes (30 + P) and total volume of mixture is (150 + P).
(30 + P) = 25/100 × (150 + P)
120 + 4P = 150 + P
=> P = 10 liters.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২১) In an examination 80% candidates passed in English and 85% candidates passed in Mathematics. If 73% candidates passed in both these subjects, then what percent of candidates failed in both the subjects?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Students passed in English = 80%
Students passed in Math's = 85%
Students passed in both subjects = 73%
Then, number of students passed in at least one subject
= (80+85)-73
= 92%.
Thus, students failed in both subjects = 100-92 = 8%

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২২) In a 729 litres mixture of milk and water, the ratio of milk to water is 7 : 2. to get a new mixture containing milk and water in the ratio 7 : 3, the amount of water to be added is:
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Quantity of milk in 729 litre of mixture
= 7 × (729/9)
= 567 litre
Quantity of water
= 729 - 567
= 162 litres
Let x litre of water be added to become ratio 7 : 3

Or, 7/3 = 567/(162+x)
Or, 162 × 7 + 7x = 567 × 3
Or, 7x = 1701 - 1134 = 567
Or, x = 567/7 = 81 litres water is to be added.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২৩) The price of the sugar rise by 25%. If a family wants to keep their expenses on sugar the same as earlier, the family will have to decrease its consumption of sugar by
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the initial expenses on Sugar was Tk. 100.
Now, Price of Sugar rises 25%. So, to buy same amount of Sugar, they need to expense,
= (100 + 25% of 100) = Tk. 125.
But, They want to keep expenses on Sugar, so they have to cut Tk. 25 in the expenses to keep it to Tk. 100.
Now, % decrease in Consumption,
(25/125)×100=20%

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২৪) Fresh grapes contain 80% while dry grapes contain 10% water. If the weight of dry grapes is 250 kg, what was its total weight when it was fresh?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Quantity of water in 250 kg dry grapes,
=(10/100)×250=25kg
Then, pulp of grapes = 225 kg
We get 20 kg pulp in 100 kg fresh grapes.
To get 225 kg pulp , we need fresh grapes,
= (100×225)/20
= 1125kg

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২৫) Two vessels P and Q contain 62.5% and 87.5% of alcohol respectively. If 2 litres from vessel P is mixed with 4 litres from vessel Q, the ratio of alcohol and water in the resulting mixture is?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Quantity of alcohol in vessel P = 62.5/100 × 2 = 5/4 litres
Quantity of alcohol in vessel Q = 87.5/100 × 4 = 7/2 litres
Quantity of alcohol in the mixture formed = 5/4 + 7/2 = 19/4 = 4.75 litres
As 6 litres of mixture is formed, ratio of alcohol and water in the mixture formed
 = 4.75 : 1.25 = 19 : 5.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২৬) In an examination 36% are pass marks. If an examine gets 17 marks and fails by 10 marks, what are the maximum marks?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Pass mark = (17 + 10) = 27
Let maximum marks be x
Then 36% of x = 27
Or, 36x/100 = 27
Or, 36x = 2700
Hence, x = 75

২৮) To gain 10% on selling sample of milk at the cost price of pure milk, the quantity of water to be mixed with 50 kg. of pure milk is:
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the quantity of water mixed be x kg.
Let CP of 1 kg of pure milk = Tk 1.

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ২৯) One quantity of wheat at Tk 9.30 per Kg is mixed with another quality at a certain rate in the ratio 8 : 7. If the mixture so formed be worth Tk 10 per Kg, what is the rate per Kg of the second quality of wheat?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Let the rate of second quality be Tk x per Kg.
C.P of 1 Kg wheat of 1st kind = 930 p
C.P of 1 Kg wheat of 2nd kind = 100x p
Mean price = 1000 p
By rule of alligation we have required ratio 8 : 7
930 x / (Mean Price) (1000) / (x-10) : 0.7
So we get required ratio, (x-10) : 0.7 :: 8 : 7
⇒ x = 10.80 per Kg

Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.question: ৩০) 40 litres of a mixture of milk and water contains 10% of water, the water to be added, to make the water content 20% in the new mixture. Find how many litres water will be added ?
Percentage, Allegation or Mixture.exp:
Water content in 40 litres of mixture.
= 40×(10/100) =4 litres
Milk in the mixture.
= 40−4=36 litres
Let x litres of water is mixed
⇒(4+x)/(40+x)=20/100
⇒x=5 litres
